doc: Downcast helper: view `kin_mem.kin_lmem` as the KINLS memory record. Panics if no linear solver memory is attached or it is not a KINLS record (the C code would blindly cast the `void*` — UB → panic). NEVER hold the returned guard across `KINProcessError`, a callback, an N_Vector op on a user-visible vector, a SUNLinearSolver/SUNMatrix call, or another borrow of the same mem.
